summary.text: John Bell is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives from District 10, which he has represented since 2013, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was elected House majority leader in 2016.

paragraphs.text: John Bell completed an undergraduate degree at the University of North Carolina Wilmington.
Ballotpedia lists him as a manager of sales and business development at North Carolina Community Federal Credit Union.
Bell was first elected to the House in 2013 and was elected house majority leader in 2016.
In the 2023-2024 session, he was assigned to the Agriculture; Alcoholic Beverage Control; Energy and Public Utilities; Finance; Health; and Rules, Calendar, and Operations of the House committees.
